label: before-engine-a

conditions.screenshots: unmasked, no resizing, full-page + native section crops

semanticMatching: Match source tag identity carried by kghq-tag-* metadata; native Details summary is the documented equivalent of its source disclosure button. Pair text after normalizing structural whitespace, smart punctuation and the documented zero-width RichText decorative-span marker; separately report actual visible punctuation mutations. Never erase pixel differences.
method: Unmasked full-page and section RGB differences (any channel delta >25); 16px local luminance SSIM; DOM box and computed-style diffs. No scaling, registration, filtering or hidden-content masks.
internalGoal: At least 95% pixels within RGB tolerance AND local SSIM >=0.95 AND section x/y/width/height within 2px AND no unmatched source elements AND no observed leaf-text mutations. Missing fonts/assets/interactions remain separate review blockers; similarity alone is not certification.
